text:
When the following fenestene begins with the fam
word with which the former concluded, it is termed
anadbigfix. As in the following influence: _Let us_
_think to price too good for truth y forth cannot be_
_bought too dies._ So in that suffage of St John: He
come to his own, and his own received him not. This
figure generally fits belt with grave and folemn dif-
counter.
